comments.author: @peterfillippsss
comments.text: Thank you once again Epic Earth for another great and informative documentary on a subject which is very relevant in todays times. I saw your notification this morning and i couldn`t wait to finish my days work, farming, so i could see what this weeks presentation was about. I really do look forward each week to your efforts as i love learning about the world, mother nature and history in general. Thank you once again, kind regards

replies.author: @EpicEarthYTB
replies.text: I can't tell you how touched I am by your words! 🙏 Knowing that someone finishes their day out in the fields, comes home, and chooses to spend their evening learning with Epic Earth means more to me than any view count ever could. Your genuine curiosity about mother nature, geography, and world history is truly inspiring. Thank you for your loyalty every week. I promise to keep putting my full heart into next week’s documentary so it’s just as worthy of your time. Wishing you safety and blessings on the farm! 🚜❤️🌍
